mentions.name: Replicide (Signalis-themed Regicide)
mentions.description: A Signalis-themed version of the Regicide card game written in Lua, published on the Lexaloffle BBS. It includes automated test suites, point-free functional programming style, and deployment to a Raspberry Pi via justfile; the git README doubles as a blog post.
